subject: CSV export fails for reports over one million rows
resolution: Raised the export row limit to five million for Pro plans and added chunked export.

subject: Dark mode chart colours are hard to read
resolution: Chart palette updated in release 4.2. Users can override series colours in Settings.

subject: SAML login loops back to the sign-in page
resolution: Identity provider clock skew caused assertion rejection. The customer synchronised NTP and login recovered.

subject: Scheduled report arrives at the wrong hour
resolution: Schedules were using UTC instead of the workspace time zone. Fixed by respecting the workspace setting.

subject: Refund requested after 45 days
resolution: Outside the 30-day window. Offered a plan downgrade credit instead.
